title: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. translated_title: 大语言模型中安全相关行为的探测与引导
translated_abstract: 激活探针是在语言模型残差流中计算出的方向，既可用于检测安全相关行为，也可通过将其方向加回残差流来引导这些行为。我们在同一条流水线、同一个模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）上，针对三种行为（欺骗、高风险意识与谄媚性），探究此类探针背后的主要设计选择之间如何相互作用。该流水线将两种估计器（均值差与逻辑回归）与三种 token 池化方案（末位、均值与可学习的注意力）进行交叉组合，为检测或引导某一行为选择合适的层，并对每个方向进行双重评估：既作为该行为的检测器，也作为将输出推向该行为的引导向量。综合此前的研究可以得出一种“读/写分离”的结论，即逻辑回归在读取（检测）时效果最好，而均值差方向在写入（引导）时效果最好。我们发现这一规律在欺骗行为和（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在统一流水线中系统探究了激活探针设计选择（估计器类型、token 池化方案、层选择）在检测与引导欺骗、高风险意识和谄媚三种安全相关行为时的相互作用，并验证了“逻辑回归最擅长检测、均值差方向最擅长引导”的读/写分离现象。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores how activation probe design choices (estimators, token-pooling schemes, layer selection) interact when detecting and steering three safety-relevant behaviours—deception, high-stakes awareness, and sycophancy—confirming a read/write dissociation where logistic regression detects best while difference-of-means directions steer best.
